sections.title: Other Events.
sections.text:
On November 2, 2026, The Procter & Gamble Company (the “Company”) closed an underwritten public
offering of $352,231,000 aggregate principal amount of Floating Rate Notes due November 2, 2076 under the
Company’s Registration Statement on Form S-3 (Registration No. 333-299472). Legal opinions related to these
notes are attached hereto as Exhibits (5)(a) and (5)(b) and are incorporated herein by reference.
